request.description: The geolocation object can be patched one of three ways. Option 1: Set the 'primary' property to true. This will set the client as the user's primary geolocation source. Option 2: Provide the 'latitude' and 'longitude' values. This will enqueue an asynchronous update of the 'city', 'region', and 'country', generating a notification. A subsequent GET operation will include the new values for 'city', 'region' and 'country'. Option 3: Provide the 'city', 'region', 'country' values. Option 1 can be combined with Option 2 or Option 3. For example, update the client as primary and provide latitude and longitude values.
